options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: ldap_account_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the LDAP account.

options.name: ldap_account_name
options.description: Name of the new LDAP account to be created. This has to match to the LDAP user or group in LDAP server to which the LDAP account is mapped.

options.name: ldap_domain_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the LDAP domain to which LDAP user or group belongs.

options.name: ldap_domain_name
options.description: Name of the LDAP domain to which LDAP user or group belongs.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: role_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the role to which the new LDAP account will be mapped.

options.name: role_name
options.description: Name of the role to which the new LDAP account will be mapped.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the LDAP account should exist or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For all other operations except delete, it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
